task.instruction: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.

final_answer:
**Compatibility: yes, iOS 17 supports the iPhone 12.** Apple's page "iPhone models compatible with iOS 17" lists the iPhone 12, along with iPhone 12 mini, 12 Pro and 12 Pro Max. The full list is iPhone XR, XS, XS Max, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, SE (2nd and 3rd generation), the 12, 13, 14 and 15 series. Apple also has an iPhone 12 page in the iOS 17 user guide. Apple notes that new features and apps may vary by iPhone model, region, language and carrier. I did not open the iPhone 12 page or Apple's Feature Availability page, so I can't give a per-feature breakdown for the iPhone 12.

Some features depend on region or newer hardware:
- Live Voicemail is U.S. and Canada only.
- Precision Finding to meet up with a friend is described for iPhone 15.
- The Action button guide covers iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max only.
- Predictive text shown inline isn't available in all countries or regions.
- AirPlay in hotel rooms is available only in select hotels.

**New features in iOS 17, from Apple's "What's new in iOS 17" page:**
- **StandBy:** Turn the iPhone on its side while charging to use it as a bedside clock, photo display or music control.
- **Interactive widgets:** Widgets on the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy can complete tasks with a tap.
- **Contact Posters and Live Voicemail:** Posters are custom call screens. Live Voicemail shows a live transcript as a caller leaves a message.
- **Stickers:** Make stickers from Memoji, photos or Live Photos, and use them anywhere the keyboard or Markup works.
- **Journal (iOS 17.2):** A new app that suggests entries from your outings, photos and workouts.
- **Messages:** Check In tells a friend when you arrive safely. You can also share or request a location, read transcripts of audio messages, and combine search filters.
- **Keyboard:** Autocorrected words are underlined so you can revert them, and predictive text appears inline.
- **FaceTime:** Leave audio or video messages, use hand-gesture reactions, and hand calls off to Apple TV.
- **AirDrop and NameDrop:** Hold two iPhones close together to swap contact info, start an AirDrop transfer or start SharePlay.
- **AirPlay (iOS 17.3):** Stream to the TV in select hotel rooms.
- **Maps:** Offline maps, plus preferred charging networks and real-time charging availability for electric vehicles.
- **Visual Look Up:** Works on paused video frames, identifies food and suggests recipes.
- **Photos:** Pets are sorted in the People & Pets album, you can change a portrait's focus point, and memories are more customizable.
- **Health:** State-of-mind logging and mental health assessments.
- **Fitness:** A redesigned Sharing tab and Custom Plans in Fitness+.
- **Screen Distance:** In Screen Time, it prompts you to move the iPhone farther away if you hold it closer than 12 inches for a long time.
- **Safari:** Separate profiles, autofilled verification codes from Mail, and password sharing with trusted contacts.
- **Privacy and security:** Sensitive Content Warning and Communication Safety cover more content, and Lockdown Mode is enhanced.
- **Accessibility:** Personal Voice with Live Speech, and Point and Speak in Magnifier.
- **Other apps:**
  - Reminders: grocery lists, sections and a column view.
  - Notes: PDFs and links between notes.
  - Freeform: new drawing tools.
  - Find My: share AirTags with up to five people.
  - News: puzzles for Apple News+ subscribers.
  - Home: Activity History.
  - Tips: new suggestions added over time.

The pages I read were Apple's Malaysia (en-my) iPhone User Guide for iOS 17. Apple's page also lists iOS 18, iOS 26 and iOS 27, so a newer iOS may exist for your iPhone 12, but I didn't check that.

judge.rationale: The agent used Apple Support pages for “What’s new in iOS 17” and “iPhone models compatible with iOS 17,” and the final page lists iPhone 12.

final_page.title: iPhone models compatible with iOS 17 – Apple Support (MY)
